item.title: Summer camps for children offered at Sault museum
item.description: Summer camps for youngsters are offered at Canadian Bushplane Heritage Centre. Camps for children five to seven run July 6-10, Aug. 10-14, Aug. 24-28 and Aug. 31-Sept. 4, a release says. Programming for children seven to 10 is offered Aug. 17-21. item.title: 'Where are the jobs?': NDP leader questions Ontario's plan for laid off Sault steelworkers
item.description: Ontario NDP leader Marit Stiles said retraining programs only help laid-off steelworkers if there are jobs to be retrained for.

item.title: Mischief done to doors, cameras at Wellington Street East building
item.description: Two men tampered with exterior door locks and security cameras to allow non-tenants into an east-end multi-unit residence, police say. The mischief in the 600 block of Wellington Street East was reported on March 4. The suspects were arrested March 6 and March 11. Winston Causley, 56, was charged with mischief. item.title: 3 teens break into Bay Street business: Police
item.description: Three teens are accused of breaking into a business in the 200 block of Bay Street. The break-in happened early Tuesday, police say. The suspects were arrested Wednesday. The accused, aged 15, 16 and 17, were charged with break and enter and mischief under $5,000. They can’t be named under the Youth Criminal Justice Act.
